```{r setup, class.source = "fold-hide"}
)

  "Koenig" = "#CAB2D6",

  "Chaffin" = "#FDBF6F",

group_levels <- c("HC", "DCM", "NICM", "MI")
```

## Load fibroblast object

```{r load fibroblast object}
FB_combined <- qs_read(
  file = here::here(fb_dir, "FB_combined.qs2"),
  nthreads = 32
)

FB_combined$Dataset <- factor(as.character(FB_combined$Dataset), levels = dataset_levels)
FB_combined$Group <- factor(as.character(FB_combined$Group), levels = group_levels)
FB_combined$cell_state <- factor(as.character(FB_combined$cell_state), levels = cell_state_levels)
FB_combined$Sample_ID <- paste0(FB_combined$Dataset, "_", FB_combined$Sample)
FB_combined$all_fibroblasts <- "Fibroblasts"

DefaultAssay(FB_combined) <- "RNA"
FB_combined <- NormalizeData(FB_combined)
Idents(FB_combined) <- "cell_state"
```

```{r object summary}
FB_combined@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Group, Sample, Sample_ID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::count(Dataset, Group, name = "n_samples") %>%
  reactable::reactable()
```

## Metacells

Metacells are generated separately within each biological sample. Fibroblast cell-state labels are not used to split the cells.

```{r select genes hdWGCNA}
DefaultAssay(FB_combined) <- "RNA"

expr_counts <- GetAssayData(
  object = FB_combined,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "counts"
)

percent_cells <- Matrix::rowSums(expr_counts > 0) / ncol(expr_counts)
wgcna_genes <- names(percent_cells[percent_cells >= wgcna_fraction])
wgcna_genes <- unique(c(wgcna_genes, "MXRA5"))

length(wgcna_genes)
"MXRA5" %in% wgcna_genes
```

```{r setup hdWGCNA}
FB_combined <- SetupForWGCNA(
  FB_combined,
  gene_select = "custom",
  gene_list = wgcna_genes,
  wgcna_name = "MXRA5_FB"
)
```

```{r metacells by sample, eval=TRUE}
FB_combined <- MetacellsByGroups(
  seurat_obj = FB_combined,
  group.by = c("Sample_ID", "all_fibroblasts"),
  reduction = "harmony",
  k = metacell_k,
  max_shared = metacell_max_shared,
  min_cells = metacell_min_cells,
  ident.group = "all_fibroblasts"
)

FB_combined <- NormalizeMetacells(FB_combined)

FB_metacells <- GetMetacellObject(FB_combined)
DefaultAssay(FB_metacells) <- "RNA"
```

```{r metacell summary}
metacell_summary <- FB_metacells@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(Sample_ID, name = "n_metacells") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    FB_combined@meta.data %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Sample, Dataset, Group) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Dataset, Group, Sample)

reactable::reactable(metacell_summary)
```

# MXRA5 co-expression across the fibroblast landscape

## Correlations within each sample

```{r genes for correlations}
metacell_counts <- GetAssayData(
  object = FB_metacells,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "counts"
)

percent_metacells <- Matrix::rowSums(metacell_counts > 0) / ncol(metacell_counts)
cor_genes <- names(percent_metacells[percent_metacells >= 0.05])
cor_genes <- unique(c(cor_genes, "MXRA5"))

length(cor_genes)
```

```{r MXRA5 correlations per sample}
metacell_mat <- GetAssayData(
  object = FB_metacells,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)

sample_ids <- unique(FB_metacells$Sample_ID)
cor_results_samples <- list()

for (sample_i in sample_ids) {
  cells_use <- colnames(FB_metacells)[FB_metacells$Sample_ID == sample_i]

  if (length(cells_use) < min_metacells_cor) next

  mat_sample <- as.matrix(
    metacell_mat[cor_genes, cells_use, drop = FALSE]
  )

  mxra5_sample <- mat_sample["MXRA5", ]

  if (sd(mxra5_sample) == 0) next

  cor_values <- apply(
    mat_sample,
    1,
    function(x) {
      if (sd(x) == 0) return(NA)
      stats::cor(x, mxra5_sample, method = "spearman")
    }
  )

  cor_results_temp <- data.frame(
    gene = names(cor_values),
    rho = as.numeric(cor_values),
    n_metacells = length(cells_use),
    Sample_ID = sample_i
  )

  cor_results_temp <- cor_results_temp %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene != "MXRA5")

  cor_results_samples[[sample_i]] <- cor_results_temp
}

cor_results_samples <- dplyr::bind_rows(cor_results_samples)

sample_metadata <- FB_combined@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Sample, Dataset, Group) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

cor_results_samples <- cor_results_samples %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_metadata, by = "Sample_ID")

write.csv(
  cor_results_samples,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "MXRA5_correlations_per_sample.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r samples retained correlations}
cor_results_samples %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Sample, Dataset, Group, n_metacells) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Dataset, Group, Sample) %>%
  reactable::reactable()
```

## Combine within-sample correlations

The Fisher-transformed correlations are combined across biological samples. Each sample contributes one correlation estimate.

```{r meta correlation MXRA5}
cor_results_meta <- cor_results_samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rho)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rho_fisher = pmax(pmin(rho, 0.999999), -0.999999),
    fisher_z = atanh(rho_fisher)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= min_samples_cor) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_samples = dplyr::n(),
    mean_rho = mean(rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rho = median(rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    fisher_z_mean = mean(fisher_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    fisher_z_se = sd(fisher_z, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    t_stat = fisher_z_mean / fisher_z_se,
    PValue = 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = dplyr::n() - 1),
    meta_r = tanh(fisher_z_mean),
    positive_samples = sum(rho > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    negative_samples = sum(rho < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(PValue), is.finite(meta_r)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(PValue, method = "BH"),
    metric = meta_r * -log10(pmax(PValue, 1e-300)),
    sign_consistency = pmax(positive_samples, negative_samples) / n_samples
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(meta_r))

write.csv(
  cor_results_meta,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "MXRA5_correlations_meta.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

reactable::reactable(
  cor_results_meta,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE
)
```

```{r top MXRA5 correlated genes, fig.width=7, fig.height=7, dpi=300}
top_positive <- cor_results_meta %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = meta_r, n = 15)

top_negative <- cor_results_meta %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = meta_r, n = 15)

top_correlated <- dplyr::bind_rows(top_negative, top_positive) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(meta_r)

top_correlated$gene <- factor(
  top_correlated$gene,
  levels = top_correlated$gene
)

ggplot(top_correlated, aes(x = gene, y = meta_r, fill = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300)))) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey85", high = "#A63A2A") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "MXRA5 correlation",
    fill = "-log10(FDR)",
    title = "MXRA5-associated genes"
  )
```

```{r MXRA5 correlation heatmap, fig.width=15, fig.height=7, dpi=300}
top_positive_genes <- cor_results_meta %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = meta_r, n = 10) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

top_negative_genes <- cor_results_meta %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = meta_r, n = 10) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

top_cor_genes <- c(top_positive_genes, top_negative_genes)

cor_heatmap <- cor_results_samples %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% top_cor_genes) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, Sample_ID, rho) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = gene,
    names_from = Sample_ID,
    values_from = rho
  ) %>%

sample_annotation <- sample_metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample_ID %in% colnames(cor_heatmap)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Dataset, Group, Sample)

cor_heatmap <- cor_heatmap[
  c(top_positive_genes, top_negative_genes),
  sample_annotation$Sample_ID,
  drop = FALSE
]

annotation_col <- sample_annotation %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Group)
rownames(annotation_col) <- sample_annotation$Sample_ID

cor_breaks <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102)

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cor_heatmap,
  color = cor_cols,
  breaks = cor_breaks,
  border_color = "white",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,

  annotation_colors = list(

  ),

  treeheight_col = 0
)
```

# Gene set enrichment analysis

```{r reorder_GO_by_pvalue}
reorder_GO_by_pvalue <- function(enrichGO_result) {
  go_results <- enrichGO_result@result
  go_results_sorted <- go_results[order(go_results$p.adjust), ]
  enrichGO_result@result <- go_results_sorted
  return(enrichGO_result)
}
```

```{r ranked genes MXRA5}
results_MXRA5 <- cor_results_meta

entrezid <- bitr(
  results_MXRA5$gene,
  fromType = "SYMBOL",
  toType = "ENTREZID",
  OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db",
  drop = TRUE
)

results_MXRA5 <- merge(
  results_MXRA5,
  entrezid,
  by.x = "gene",
  by.y = "SYMBOL",
  all.x = TRUE
)

results_MXRA5[duplicated(results_MXRA5$metric) | duplicated(results_MXRA5$metric, fromLast = TRUE), ]
results_MXRA5 <- results_MXRA5[!duplicated(results_MXRA5$metric), ]

ranked_genes <- results_MXRA5[!is.na(results_MXRA5$ENTREZID), ]
ranked_genes <- ranked_genes[!duplicated(ranked_genes$ENTREZID), ]

genelist <- ranked_genes$metric
names(genelist) <- ranked_genes$ENTREZID
genelist <- genelist[order(genelist, decreasing = TRUE)]

write.csv(
  results_MXRA5,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "MXRA5_ranked_genes_GSEA.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r classify_terms}
classify_terms <- function(df) {
  df$sign <- ifelse(df$NES > 0, "activated", "suppressed")
  return(df)
}
```


```{r default_labeller}
default_labeller <- function(n) {
  function(str) {
    str <- gsub("_", " ", str)
    ep_str_wrap(str, n)
  }
}
```

```{r barplot.enrichResult}
barplot.enrichResult <- function(height, x = "Count", color = "p.adjust", showCategory = 8,
                                 font.size = 12, title = "", label_format = 30, ...) {
  object <- height
  colorBy <- match.arg(color, c("pvalue", "p.adjust", "qvalue"))
  if (x == "geneRatio" || x == "GeneRatio") {
    x <- "GeneRatio"
  }
  else if (x == "count" || x == "Count") {
    x <- "Count"
  }
  df <- fortify(object, showCategory = showCategory, by = x, ...)
  if (colorBy %in% colnames(df)) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x, y = "Description", fill = colorBy)) +
      theme_dose(font.size) +
      set_enrichplot_color(type = "fill", name = color)
  }
  else {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x, y = "Description", fill = "Description")) +
      theme_dose(font.size) +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  label_func <- default_labeller(label_format)
  if (is.function(label_format)) {
    label_func <- label_format
  }
  p + geom_col() + scale_y_discrete(labels = label_func) +
    ggtitle(title) + ylab(NULL)
}
```

```{r ep_str_wrap}
ep_str_wrap <- function(string, width) {
  x <- gregexpr(' ', string)
  vapply(
    seq_along(x),
    FUN = function(i) {
      y <- x[[i]]
      n <- nchar(string[i])
      len <- (c(y, n) - c(0, y))
      idx <- len > width
      j <- which(!idx)
      if (length(j) && max(j) == length(len)) {
        j <- j[-length(j)]
      }
      if (length(j)) {
        idx[j] <- len[j] + len[j + 1] > width
      }
      idx <- idx[-length(idx)]
      start <- c(1, y[idx] + 1)
      end <- c(y[idx] - 1, n)
      words <- substring(string[i], start, end)
      paste0(words, collapse = "\n")
    },
    FUN.VALUE = character(1)
  )
}
```

```{r GSEA_GO_simplified_barplot_top20_up_down MXRA5, fig.width=8, fig.height=5.3, dpi=300}
    axis.text.y = element_text(lineheight = 0.7, size = 11)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score")
```

## KEGG

```{r save GSEA_KEGG MXRA5, eval=TRUE}
GSEA_KEGG <- gseKEGG(
  geneList = genelist,
  organism = "hsa",
  keyType = "kegg",
  nPermSimple = 100000,
  minGSSize = 10
)

saveRDS(
  GSEA_KEGG,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "FB_GSEA_KEGG_MXRA5.rds")
)
```

```{r GSEA KEGG dotplot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(GSEA_KEGG@result) > 0) {

  dotplot(
    GSEA_KEGG,
    showCategory = 10,
    split = ".sign",
    title = paste0("GSEA\nKEGG Pathways", "\n MXRA5-associated genes"),
    label_format = 35,
    font.size = 15
  ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18)
    ) +
    facet_grid(. ~ .sign)

} else {
  message("No significant KEGG pathways identified.")
}
```

```{r GSEA_Reactome_emapplot MXRA5, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
GSEA_Reactome@result <- classify_terms(GSEA_Reactome@result)

activated_terms <- subset(GSEA_Reactome@result, sign == "activated")
suppressed_terms <- subset(GSEA_Reactome@result, sign == "suppressed")

GSEA_Reactome_activated <- GSEA_Reactome
GSEA_Reactome_activated@result <- activated_terms
GSEA_Reactome_activated <- pairwise_termsim(GSEA_Reactome_activated)

p1 <- emapplot(
  GSEA_Reactome_activated,
  showCategory = 100,
  node_label_size = 3.5,
  min_edge = 0.15
) +
  ggtitle("Positively associated pathways") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5))

p1 
```

```{r GSEA_Reactome_barplot_top20_up_down MXRA5, fig.width=8, fig.height=5.3, dpi=300}
top_up <- GSEA_Reactome@result %>%
  dplyr::filter(NES > 0) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(order_by = NES, n = 20)

top_down <- GSEA_Reactome@result %>%
  dplyr::filter(NES < 0) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(order_by = NES, n = 20)

top_terms <- dplyr::bind_rows(top_up, top_down)

GSEA_Reactome_top40 <- GSEA_Reactome
GSEA_Reactome_top40@result <- top_terms

barplot.enrichResult(
  reorder_GO_by_NES(GSEA_Reactome_top40),
  x = "NES",
  showCategory = 100,
  label_format = 45
) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 50)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Reactome Pathway Enrichment Analysis\nMXRA5-associated terms") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(lineheight = 0.7, size = 11)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score")
```

# hdWGCNA

## Expression matrix and soft power

```{r hdWGCNA expression matrix}
DefaultAssay(FB_combined) <- "RNA"

FB_combined <- SetDatExpr(
  FB_combined,
  group_name = "Fibroblasts",
  group.by = "all_fibroblasts",
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"
)
```

```{r hdWGCNA soft powers, eval=TRUE}
FB_combined <- TestSoftPowers(
  FB_combined,
  networkType = "signed"
)

power_table <- GetPowerTable(FB_combined)
reactable::reactable(power_table)
```

```{r hdWGCNA soft power plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=7, dpi=300}
plot_list <- PlotSoftPowers(FB_combined)
patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2)
```

## Co-expression network

```{r construct hdWGCNA network, eval=TRUE}
FB_combined <- ConstructNetwork(
  FB_combined,
  tom_name = "FB_MXRA5",
  tom_outdir = network_scratch
)
```

```{r hdWGCNA dendrogram, fig.width=12, fig.height=5, dpi=300}
PlotDendrogram(
  FB_combined,
  main = "Fibroblast hdWGCNA dendrogram"
)
```

## Module eigengenes and connectivity

```{r hdWGCNA module eigengenes, eval=TRUE}
FB_combined <- ModuleEigengenes(
  FB_combined,
  group.by.vars = "Dataset"
)

FB_combined <- ModuleConnectivity(
  FB_combined,
  group.by = "all_fibroblasts",
  group_name = "Fibroblasts"
)

FB_combined <- ResetModuleNames(
  FB_combined,
  new_name = "FB-M"
)
```

```{r hdWGCNA modules}
modules <- GetModules(FB_combined)

write.csv(
  modules,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "FB_hdWGCNA_modules.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

reactable::reactable(
  modules,
  filterable = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE
)
```

```{r MXRA5 module}
MXRA5_module <- modules %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_name == "MXRA5") %>%
  dplyr::pull(module)

MXRA5_module

MXRA5_info <- modules %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_name == "MXRA5")

reactable::reactable(MXRA5_info)
```

```{r MXRA5 module hub genes}
MXRA5_hub_genes <- GetHubGenes(
  FB_combined,
  n_hubs = 50,
  mods = MXRA5_module
)

write.csv(
  MXRA5_hub_genes,
  here::here(output_dir_data, "FB_MXRA5_module_hub_genes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

reactable::reactable(MXRA5_hub_genes)
```

```{r MXRA5 module top hub genes, fig.width=7, fig.height=6, dpi=300}
MXRA5_module_color <- modules %>%
  dplyr::filter(module == MXRA5_module) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(color)

MXRA5_top_hubs <- MXRA5_hub_genes %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 25) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(kME)

MXRA5_top_hubs$gene_name <- factor(
  MXRA5_top_hubs$gene_name,
  levels = MXRA5_top_hubs$gene_name
)

ggplot(MXRA5_top_hubs, aes(x = gene_name, y = kME)) +
  geom_col(fill = MXRA5_module_color) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "kME",
    title = paste0(MXRA5_module, " hub genes")
  )
```

## Module activity across fibroblasts

```{r hdWGCNA all module feature plots, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, dpi=300}
plot_list <- ModuleFeaturePlot(
  FB_combined,
  features = "hMEs",
  order_points = TRUE,
  restrict_range = FALSE,
  point_size = 0.1,
  raster = FALSE
)

patchwork::wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4)
```

```{r MXRA5 and MXRA5 module UMAP, fig.width=12, fig.height=4, dpi=300}
Idents(FB_combined) <- "cell_state"

p1 <- DimPlot(
  FB_combined,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "cell_state",
  cols = cell_type_cols,
  label = TRUE,
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.1,
  raster = FALSE
) +
  NoLegend() +
  ggtitle("Cell states") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

DefaultAssay(FB_combined) <- "RNA"
p2 <- FeaturePlot_scCustom(
  FB_combined,
  features = "MXRA5",
  pt.size = 0.1,
  order = TRUE
) +
  ggtitle("MXRA5 expression") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

p3 <- ModuleFeaturePlot(
  FB_combined,
  module_names = MXRA5_module,
  features = "hMEs",
  order_points = TRUE,
  restrict_range = FALSE,
  point_size = 0.1,
  raster = FALSE
)[[1]] +
  ggtitle(paste0(MXRA5_module, " activity")) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

p1 | p2 | p3
```

```{r MXRA5 module across cell states, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, dpi=300}
hMEs <- GetMEs(FB_combined, harmonized = TRUE)

module_metadata <- FB_combined@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_state) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    MXRA5_module = hMEs[, MXRA5_module]
  )

ggplot(module_metadata, aes(x = cell_state, y = MXRA5_module, fill = cell_state)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_type_cols[seq_along(cell_state_levels)]) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Harmonized module eigengene",
    title = paste0(MXRA5_module, " across fibroblast states")
  )
```

## Compact reusable results

```{r save compact reusable results}
write.csv(metacell_summary, file.path(output_dir_data, "FB_metacell_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(gene = wgcna_genes), file.path(output_dir_data, "FB_network_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(power_table, file.path(output_dir_data, "FB_soft_power_diagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(GSEA_GO_simplified, file.path(output_dir_data, "FB_GSEA_GO_MXRA5_simplified.rds"))
all_module_hubs <- GetHubGenes(FB_combined, n_hubs = 50)
write.csv(all_module_hubs, file.path(output_dir_data, "FB_all_module_hub_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
module_eigengenes <- GetMEs(FB_combined, harmonized = FALSE)
harmonized_eigengenes <- GetMEs(FB_combined, harmonized = TRUE)
module_cell_metadata <- FB_combined@meta.data[, c("Sample_ID", "Sample", "Dataset", "Group", "cell_state"), drop = FALSE]
saveRDS(list(eigengenes = module_eigengenes,
             harmonized_eigengenes = harmonized_eigengenes,
             cell_metadata = module_cell_metadata),
        file.path(output_dir_data, "FB_module_eigengenes.rds"), compress = TRUE)
saveRDS(list(wgcna_fraction = wgcna_fraction, metacell_k = metacell_k,
             metacell_max_shared = metacell_max_shared, metacell_min_cells = metacell_min_cells,
             target_metacells = 1000, min_metacells_cor = min_metacells_cor,
             min_samples_cor = min_samples_cor, seed = 12345,
             network_parameters = GetWGCNAParams(FB_combined)),
        file.path(output_dir_data, "FB_network_parameters.rds"))
```
